Finished in timeless Alpine White over Yas Marina Blue/Black leather, this 2026 BMW M3 delivers one of the last truly analog high-performance driving experiences available today. Showing just 5,000 miles from new, this meticulously optioned M3 pairs BMWs legendary 473-horsepower twin-turbocharged inline-six with the enthusiast-favorite 6-speed manual transmission a combination that continues to define the modern sport sedan segment. This example was configured with an original MSRP of $86,640 and features an ideal specification highlighted by the Executive Package, forged staggered M wheels, carbon fiber interior trim, ventilated front seats, Harman Kardon surround sound, and extended Shadowline styling. Built in Munich, Germany and delivered new through BMW of Las Vegas, this M3 remains an exceptionally clean, highly collectible example of BMW M engineering. Performance comes from a 3.0-liter BMW M TwinPower Turbo inline-six producing 473 horsepower, sent to the rear wheels through a proper 6-speed manual gearbox and M Sport Differential. Adaptive M Suspension, M Compound brakes, and BMWs M Driving Dynamics systems provide razor-sharp handling while maintaining daily usability. The manual-transmission G80 M3 has already become one of the most sought-after enthusiast configurations, offering a level of engagement increasingly absent from modern performance cars. Factory options and highlights include: Alpine White exterior Yas Marina Blue/Black extended leather interior 6-Speed Manual Transmission Executive Package BMW Curved Display with Head-Up Display Full LED Headlights with Cornering Function Galvanic interior controls 19/20 M Dual-Spoke Black Forged Wheels Adaptive M Suspension M Compound Brakes with Black Calipers Carbon Fiber Interior Trim Front Ventilated Seats Heated Front Seats Heated Steering Wheel Harman Kardon Surround Sound System Apple CarPlay & Android Auto Wireless Charging Personal eSIM 5G Connectivity M Shadowline Lights Extended Shadowline Exterior Trim Comfort Access Keyless Entry Power Tailgate M Seat Belts Driving Assistant Package Front & Rear Park Distance Control Rear View Camera BMW Wheel Locks M Performance Floor Mats The cabin blends modern BMW technology with unmistakable M-car character. Heated and ventilated M Sport Seats are trimmed in Yas Marina Blue/Black leather, while carbon fiber trim and M seat belts add a motorsport-inspired atmosphere. BMWs latest Curved Display integrates navigation, media, and vehicle functions seamlessly, complemented by a Head-Up Display and Harman Kardon premium audio system. With only 5,000 miles, this M3 presents in outstanding condition throughout and benefits from the balance of BMWs factory warranty, roadside assistance, and Ultimate Care maintenance coverage. The car retains all the everyday practicality expected from a luxury sedan while delivering the visceral driving experience enthusiasts continue to chase. For buyers seeking one of the last great manual-transmission super sedans equally capable as a daily driver, canyon carver, or future collectible this 2026 BMW M3 stands among the best examples available today.

Its dedicated electric architecture allows for an exceptionally spacious interior, an impressively low drag coefficient for increased efficiency, and a remarkably composed ride that feels more like a flagship limousine than a traditional luxury sedan. The result is an electric vehicle designed to make every journey relaxing rather than simply fast. Critics Commentary Professional reviewers consistently praised the EQS for its exceptionally smooth ride quality, near-silent cabin, advanced technology, luxurious interior craftsmanship, and outstanding highway refinement. Industry experts also highlighted how naturally the electric powertrain delivers effortless acceleration while preserving the calm, sophisticated driving experience expected from Mercedes-Benz's flagship sedans. Rather than feeling like a traditional luxury sedan converted to electric power, reviewers frequently described the EQS as a purpose-built luxury EV whose engineering allows nearly every aspect of the driving experience to feel exceptionally polished and cohesive. Awards & Recognition The EQS quickly established itself as one of the benchmark luxury electric sedans in the industry. Multiple IIHS TOP SAFETY PICK recognitions across the EQS family Widely recognized for exceptional aerodynamic engineering Frequently recommended among the world's premier luxury electric sedans Consistently praised for ride comfort, cabin refinement, and advanced technology Recognized as one of the most technologically advanced Mercedes-Benz production vehicles ever built Warranty The odometer is hovering around the 13,161-mile mark, and it is STILL COVERED by the factory. AIR-BALANCE Package enhances cabin comfort by combining fragrance, air purification, and ionization for a noticeably fresher interior environment. Four-zone automatic climate control allows each occupant to customize individual temperature settings for exceptional passenger comfort. Standalone Features Natural Grain Yacht Design dashboard, center console, and door trim showcase beautifully finished open-pore walnut accented by elegant aluminum inlays, creating a warm, handcrafted atmosphere throughout the cabin. Rapid Heating Front Seats reach comfortable temperatures remarkably quickly during cold weather, reducing wait times while enhancing year-round comfort. Heated Steering Wheel adds another level of cold-weather luxury by warming one of the most frequently touched surfaces inside the cabin. ENERGIZING AIR CONTROL Plus with HEPA Filtration continuously monitors cabin air quality while using an advanced HEPA filtration system to help reduce dust, pollen, and other airborne particles entering the interior. Grey microfiber headliner adds visual richness while contributing to the quiet, premium ambiance expected from Mercedes-Benz's flagship electric sedan. Head-Up Display projects important driving information directly into the driver's line of sight, allowing speed, navigation, and driver-assistance information to be viewed while keeping attention focused on the road ahead. Every example benefits from an advanced dedicated electric platform, exceptional aerodynamic efficiency, premium craftsmanship, sophisticated suspension engineering, and an extensive suite of comfort, technology, and driver-assistance systems designed to make every journey effortless. Unlike many luxury vehicles that emphasize individual features, the EQS focuses on creating a seamless ownership experience where comfort, refinement, technology, efficiency, and performance work together naturally. Beyond its impressive range, the EQS also benefits from intelligent regenerative braking that helps recover energy during deceleration, contributing to both efficiency and smoother driving. Home charging covers the vast majority of daily driving needs, while an expanding public fast-charging network makes extended road trips increasingly practical without sacrificing the luxurious ownership experience expected from a Mercedes-Benz flagship. Unlike a traditional gasoline engine that builds power as revs increase, the electric powertrain delivers maximum torque almost immediately, allowing the EQS to accelerate with remarkable smoothness and effortless authority. Whether merging onto the highway or quietly pulling away from a stoplight, power delivery feels immediate yet refined. Mercedes-Benz pairs those dual motors with its renowned 4MATIC ALL-WHEEL DRIVE system, continuously distributing power between the front and rear axles to maximize traction, stability, and driver confidence. Rain, snow, or dry pavement, the intelligent drivetrain constantly adjusts to changing conditions while maintaining the composed character expected from the brand's flagship sedan. Rather than emphasizing sporting stiffness, the EQS was engineered around long-distance comfort. Sophisticated suspension tuning, exceptionally low cabin noise, and meticulous chassis engineering allow rough pavement to be absorbed with remarkable composure. Combined with regenerative braking that recovers energy during deceleration, every journey feels exceptionally smooth, quiet, and relaxing. Every design element serves both aesthetic and functional purposes, creating a sedan that looks modern today while remaining unmistakably luxurious. Large alloy wheels, beautifully integrated exterior trim, and Twilight Blue Metallic paint complete an appearance that feels elegant rather than flashy. The result is a flagship sedan that attracts attention through refinement and engineering instead of unnecessary visual excess. Interior Features Inside, the EQS surrounds its occupants with an environment that feels more like a contemporary luxury lounge than a traditional automobile. Premium leather seating surfaces, handcrafted natural-grain Yacht Design wood trim, refined metallic accents, and meticulous attention to detail create an atmosphere that immediately communicates craftsmanship and quality. Both front occupants benefit from exceptionally supportive multi-contour seating designed for outstanding long-distance comfort. Multiple massage programs, rapid seat heating, a heated steering wheel, individualized four-zone climate control, and thoughtfully designed ergonomics help reduce fatigue whether commuting across town or traveling hundreds of miles in a single day. Passengers also enjoy the advantages of the EQS's dedicated electric architecture, which allows for generous interior space without sacrificing elegant proportions. The nearly flat floor, spacious seating, premium materials, and exceptionally quiet cabin combine to create an environment where conversation, relaxation, and travel become equally enjoyable. Infotainment Features Mercedes-Benz designed the EQS around an advanced digital ecosystem that makes interacting with the vehicle feel intuitive rather than complicated. High-resolution displays, intelligent software, natural voice recognition, and sophisticated graphics work together to create one of the most advanced infotainment experiences available in any production luxury sedan. Wireless smartphone integration, Bluetooth connectivity, navigation, multiple USB charging locations, connected vehicle services, and the available Head-Up Display help keep drivers informed while minimizing distractions. MBUX Front Interior Assist further enhances convenience by recognizing natural movements and gestures to control selected vehicle functions without unnecessary button presses. Beyond connectivity, technology throughout the EQS is designed to improve the ownership experience. Features such as the integrated factory Dashcam, customizable digital displays, intelligent climate management, and advanced wellness technologies help transform everyday driving into a more comfortable, personalized, and enjoyable experience. Safety Features Safety has long been one of Mercedes-Benz's defining engineering priorities, and the EQS continues that tradition with an extensive network of active and passive safety technologies working together to help protect occupants while reducing driver workload. Rather than relying on a single system, numerous electronic safety features continuously monitor changing road conditions to provide additional confidence behind the wheel. Advanced driver-assistance technologies can include Forward Collision Warning with Automatic Emergency Braking, Blind Spot Assist, Active Lane Keeping Assist, Adaptive Cruise Control, Rear Cross Traffic Alert, parking sensors, multiple camera systems, and numerous additional electronic systems that work together to support the driver during everyday travel. Each feature is designed to provide timely assistance while allowing the driver to remain fully engaged. Safety and Security
  • Lane departure prevention - Keep it between the lines. It only takes a moment of inattention for your vehicle to drift. With lane departure prevention, your vehicle takes corrective action to help you avoid unintentionally moving out of your lane. Lane departure prevention is an extra level of safety for you and those around you.
  • Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.
  • Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.
  • Hands-on cruise control. Set it and forget it. Road trips used to be stressful. Cruise control only managed speed, but not distance or safety. Now, with hands-on cruise control, simply set your desired speed and let sensor technology maintain a safe distance between you and surrounding vehicles. It slows you down, speeds you up and even keeps you in your own lane. Meet your ultimate co-pilot with hands-on cruise control.
  • Rear camera - Watching your back! The rear camera helps you see obstacles and hazards you otherwise couldn't by showing enhanced images of what is behind you. The rear camera is an extra set of eyes that's both convenient and safe.
Technology and Telematics
  • Audi smartphone interface (wireless Apple CarPlay/wired Android Auto) smart device wireless mirroring
